people.name: Nineveh
people.line: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance

translations.web: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
translations.bsb: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you.”
